stem:
Freddie had $256 in his bank account.  
• On Monday he put $50 more into his account.  
• On Tuesday he took out $87 to buy a bicycle.  
Which equation can be used to find the amount of money Freddie had in his bank account after he took out money on Tuesday?
visual_elements: equations with blanks for answers: A 256 - 50 - 87 = □, B 256 + 50 + 87 = □, C 250 - 50 + 87 = □, D 256 + 50 - 87 = □
difficulty_rationale: The problem requires a straightforward one-step arithmetic equation creation based on adding and subtracting amounts from the initial value.
